newsitem.title: turkey: SOCCER-OLIVERA HAT-TRICK HANDS BELGIUM VITAL WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OLIVERA HAT-TRICK HANDS BELGIUM VITAL WIN.

text.p: A first-half hat-trick by Luis Olivera gave Belgium an important 3-1 away victory over Turkey in their group seven World Cup qualifying match on Wednesday.
Belgium kpet pace with the Dutch at the top of the group but Turkey's chances of making the finals in France next year now look remote.
All four goals came in an action-packed opening period with Olivera tapping in Emile Lokonda Mpenza's cross to get things moving after 12 minutes.

The pace of Olivera was too much for the Turks. He headed the second in the 31st minute, finishing off an Enzo Scifo cross, and grabbed his third from close range just before the halftime after leaving his marker for dead.
"Our opponents played much better than us and deserved the victory," Turkey's coach, Mustafa Denizli said.
Turkey had briefly made it 2-1 in the 35th minute with a marvellous individual goal by Oktay Derelioglu who beat the entire Belgian defence before firing past Filip De Vilde.
"With this defeat our hopes of reaching the finals are just about finished," Denizli said.
Group leaders the Netherlands are on 15 points after thrashing San Marino 6-0. They are three clear of Belgium and eight ahead of Turkey who have a veritable mountain to move.
